title: 116 Gulfside Way | Scenic Stays
meta_description: Located in Gulfside Cottages in Miramar Beach, 116 Gulfside Way is ideally situated just steps from the beach and the beautiful Gulf of Mexico! With quick and convenient beach access, a heated community pool, and stunning grounds, this hidden gem is the coastal oasis you’ve been looking for!
description_expanded: Located in Gulfside Cottages in Miramar Beach, 116 Gulfside Way is ideally situated just steps from the beach and the beautiful Gulf of Mexico! With quick and convenient beach access, a heated community pool, and stunning grounds, this hidden gem is the coastal oasis you’ve been looking for! 116 Gulfside Way is a spacious cottage-style home with two bedrooms and two and a half baths accommodating up to seven. This spacious retreat offers a delightful Southern welcome with a front porch meant for relaxing. Enter to find stunning coastal-themed interiors with spacious rooms and light-filled spaces designed for comfort. You’ll find plenty of room in the open-concept living/dining area for the whole gang to gather together. Curl up on the sofa and watch a movie on the flat-screen TV or challenge others to a friendly board or card game at the dining room table. The kitchen is beautifully appointed and the perfect spot for preparing both light snacks and hearty meals. Private porches await off spacious second-floor bedrooms, each with a king-sized bed, en suite bath, and a flat-screen TV. Relax in comfort while the kids pile in the twin bunk with trundle, a cozy spot just for them. The stackable washer and dryer are convenient for quick cleanups, while the covered carport offers plenty of room for all your beach toys. Enjoy leisurely walks through the quiet community complete with white picket fences, a heated pool, and quick access to the beach via the neighborhood access. Venture off the property for a quick nine at the Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort, or browse the shops at Grand Boulevard and Silver Sands Premium Outlets. Afterward, take your pick between a host of nearby restaurants for a delicious lunch or dinner overlooking the beach! Please note: a dog is permitted, but it must be under 75 lbs and the non-refundable pet fee is an additional $300. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
rooms_guidance: Bunk Bed and Trundle on 1st floor
